column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so an iPhone takes a smaller guest block, as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# pso_sync_all: a draw whose pipeline the cache lacks is never skipped (vka_psosync.h VKPS_ALL). The first capture on the Motorola Edge 30 Fusion (2026-11-20,
# 0.1.5-dev) was a first run - empty pipeline cache, no prewarm seed - and kept, for the whole session, what draws into larger targets made while their pipelines
# compiled in the background (docs/reference/rendering.md "A draw skipped for its pipeline left a result the game kept", its Open item): the character creator's
# model in a flat bright green coat with a green bloom and black skin, and the Professor Fig cutscene in dark silhouettes with a blown-out white region. Off again
# tex_stream_track: a compressed (BCn) texture in a pool the CPU can write is tracked from its storage whatever its COMPRESSIBLE flag and whether its storage holds
# anything at the upload (vka_tex.c storage_mode, vka_texstream.h; DM_VK_BCN_ZEROLOG names the compressed zero images it misses). This game runs on a Switch 1 SDK
# (16.2.3, spec NX), so the NVN2 first-sampled rule never runs (vka_nvn2() 0), and its UE4 streamer fills compressed texture slots after the texture's first use:
# untracked, the image keeps the slot's zeros (the creator's black model) or what shares the memory (the flat green coat) and the streamer's later CPU writes never
# reach it. Off is the default for every other profile
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
